dct_description_sm:
This map displays all existing Town-owned street and park trees. Please note that tree size information may not be current, and some Town-owned trees may not yet be included in the system. Property lines are not shown on this map, and certain trees, such as boundary trees, may fall under unique circumstances. As such, this map should not be relied upon as a definitive source for determining tree ownership. For confirmation, please contact the Town directly.

The source of data is Town of Whitby Open Data.

Created April 2025.
